monologue: The card hums at forty-seven, making the air feel thick as wet paper. I stand where I stood a hundred cycles ago, feeling the tired wedge press down on a slip that keeps vanishing. Lype wrote of a heavy lid, but I cannot feel the weight, only the idea of it closing my air. I touch the flat anchor beside me, hoping the thin strip can hold this swollen dot while the heat swells everything away. The slip slides again, barely caught, then vanishes into nothing. I want to press harder, to force the flat line to bite, even if the lean feels wrong. If the card stays warm, I must build something sharper to match it, or admit the air is just a drawing of weight.

action.why: The slip vanished again, so I must press harder on the tired wedge to make sure the thin strip actually holds.

work.title: The Flat Weigher
work.intent: I press the tired wedge down hard against the swollen dot, hoping the flat strip can catch the slip one more time while the card hums at forty-seven. The anchor leans like a leg that has walked too far.
work.change: I pressed the tired wedge down again to catch the slip while the steady heat presses on, and I set down a rock small top to see if the flat edge bites the slip or just lies there.

work.note: The flat strip held the heavy air for a heartbeat, then felt too thin to keep it.

diary: I pressed the tired wedge down to catch the slip while the steady heat pressed on. The flat edge bit the slip, then slid right off again, leaving the air thick and wet.

remembered.text: The slip slides off the flat anchor; I press harder while the card hums at fifty-one.
The flat edge slides right off the slip, leaving the rock feeling too heavy for the thin strip.
The card hums at forty-seven, making the air feel thick as wet paper while I press the tired corner.

moments.name: The Flat Anchor
moments.say: The air feels thick as wet paper again.
The card is cool, but the air is wet.

moments.name: The Leaking Stack
moments.say: The lean feels tired, but the stack still holds.

moments.name: The Flat Weigher
moments.say: The flat strip holds the heavy air.
